title: Notes campaign / street-wide sequence

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Evaluate an installation from its approach view so separate panels read as one environment.
strategic_value: Repeated gradient and glyph cues can link multiple Instagram messages along the street.
demonstration: A wider street view adds a photographic panel to the message and gradient walls, with road markings and barriers in the foreground.
practical_value: Use a distant view to assess recognition across the full sequence rather than judging each panel alone.

content_islands.name: Wall sequence
content_islands.spec: Retain the photographic panel, message panel and elevated glyph wall together.

content_islands.name: Approach context
content_islands.spec: Keep the street and barriers visible to establish distance and interruptions.

reference_purposes.Application: The wider view demonstrates how the wall series is encountered from across the road.
